pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's Proposition environment at source lines 505-508 (label Prop:EB=EC), asserting that two nested localising tensor ideals give isomorphic weak rings of pure-injectives, compatibly with the units; the proof environment at source lines 510-534 immediately follows it and is its own proof. The proof factors the Gabriel quotient into two steps, computes the intermediate object as the image of EC, compares injective hulls of the unit to get a split monomorphism, and uses exactness of the intermediate localisation with full faithfulness of its right adjoint to show the complementary summand vanishes, then descends the isomorphism by a cited clause; all of it is inside the counted span. Four navigation stubs are attached, the construction Cons:E_C and the propositions Prop:ring-in-AB, Prop:A/C and its clause it:A/C-d (two of these labels contain a slash, which the assembler whitelist now admits).
